hbc.html:
HAPPY BOOST™ LENS

PROPRIETARY LENS TECHNOLOGY

Built for Hardcore Saltwater Anglers. SPY+ Happy Boost™ lens tech cuts through harsh glare and boosts color and contrast up to 30% more than the competition. From scanning flats to chasing offshore foam, it preserves white balance and keeps your vision dialed. Made for captains, deckhands, and lifers who fish for a living—and live to fish.

HAPPY™ POLAR LENS

PROPRIETARY LENS TECHNOLOGY

SPY+ Happy Polar™ fights back with premium polarization that cuts surface reflection while preserving the vivid detail serious anglers count on. Unlike basic tints, it lets in long-wave blue light—boosting alertness and reducing fatigue—so your eyes stay sharp from cast to gaff. Built to see what others miss.

ANSI Z87-2+ CERTIFICATION

Flying jigs. Heavy chop. Leaders snapping under pressure. Saltwater life isn't gentle. The SPY+ Waterman Collection features multiple fully ANSI Z87.1 certified frames—built to take a beating. We over-test for endurance so you don't have to second-guess when things get sketchy.

PRESCRIPTION READY

Skill gets you far—gear takes you further. Your vision is your most vital tool on the water, so don't sacrifice clarity, safety, or performance.
SPY+ prescription sunglasses are built with the same performance DNA, available in Happy™ and Happy Boost™ lens tech. Z87-2+ frames ensure your custom RX lenses are impact-rated too, not just the frame.
